a.xlink:title: Developer-set per-host allowance ceilings (requests/second), keyed by host.
Effective per-host allowance ceiling for a host.
Returns the display label for a URL, including its current effective rate limit.
Whether a host may skip dispatch pacing and per-host allowance entirely.
Processes a single queued request.
Handles a server returning HTTP 429 by reducing that host's request quota.
Resets the request quota for rate-limiting.
Chooses a request from the queue and starts it, respecting the quota and pacing.
Constructs a CardPictureLoaderWorker.
Constructs a worker for downloading a specific card image.
Handles image load requests enqueued on this worker.
Request that a URL be downloaded.
Processes a failed network reply.
Processes a successful network reply.
Starts downloading the next URL for this card.
Handles a finished network reply for the card image.
Makes a network request for the given URL using the specified worker.
Queues a network request for a given URL and worker thread.
Called when all URLs have been exhausted or download failed.
Schedules a deferred retry after the relevant server backoff expires.
Adds a list item for the given URL, storing the raw URL alongside its displayed label.
Refreshes the displayed label of every URL item after limits or settings change.
